To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) PTP1B is a substrate of the IL-4-Jak1-Stat6 pathway; 2) IL-4 enhances PTP1b protein stability; 3) PTP1b negatively regulates the IL-4-Stat6 pathway.
PTP1 B negatively regulates IL-4-induced JAK-STAT6 signal transduction and that IL-4-induced PTP1 B expression and protein stability contribute to this negative regulatory function.
PTP1b dephosphorylates phosphorylated STAT6 and negatively regulates STAT6 signaling in response to IL4.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of PTP1 in regulating the signaling of the cytokine, IL-4.
the regulation of IL4 signaling and how this regulation is altered in neoplastic processes.
the regulation of cytokine signaling by protein tyrosine phosphates and their role in the development of inflammatory and neoplastic disease.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PTP1b is a negative regulator in IL-4-induced Stat6 signaling.
the PTP1B-STAT6 signaling pathway is a negative regulator in the IL-4-induced JAK-STAT signaling pathway.
PTP1b is a negative regulator for IL4-induced STAT6 phosphorylation and signaling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PTP1 protein tyrosine phosphotase 1B is a novel negative regulator of interlekin-4 (IL- 4)-mediated signaling and may have a role in the regulation of inflammatory responses and neoplasia.
PTP1b is a negative regulator for STAT6 signaling, which may be important for both neoplastic processes such as diffuse large B-cell like lymphomas and inflammatory diseases such as asthma.
PTP1 is a negative regulator for IL4-induced STAT6 activation, which can be regulated by IL-4 in an autoregulatory manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
protein tyrosine phosphotase 1B is a novel negative regulator of interleuikin 4-induced signal transducer and activator of transcription 6 (STAT6) signaling.
protein tyrosine phosphates 1B is a new negative regulator of interleukein 4-induced signal transducer and activator of transcription 6 (STAT6) signaling.
PTP1b negatively regulates IL4-STAT6 signaling by direct dephosphoryation of STAT6.
